python3 << 'EOF'
text = "aaa bbb ccc"
width = 7
words = text.split()
print(f"Words: {words}")
print(f"Width: {width}")

lines = []
cur = ""
for w in words:
    extra = len(w) + (1 if cur else 0)
    print(f"w={w!r}, len(w)={len(w)}, cur={cur!r}, extra={extra}, len(cur)+extra={len(cur)+extra}")
    if len(cur) + extra > width:
        lines.append(cur)
        print(f"Appended line: {lines[-1]!r}")
        cur = w
    else:
        cur = f"{cur} {w}" if cur else w
        print(f"Cur now: {cur!r}")

if cur:
    lines.append(cur)
    print(f"Final line appended: {lines[-1]!r}")

print(f"Result: {lines}")
